scenes.narration: Every live biotherapeutic starts with the same gamble: a peptide designed by guesswork. Cozy Peptide replaces the guesswork. Name the disease — get a novel AI-designed peptide, screened for safety, compiled to DNA, ready for engineered bacteria to produce locally. No pharma factory, no ten-year pipeline — just a designed DNA order and a bacterial chassis. Watch one get designed, live.
Start with a real target: C. difficile gut infection. One click selects it — the designer picks the best scaffold and bacterial factory for this target: a hairpin peptide brewed in E. coli Nissle.

scenes.narration: Out comes a verified peptide sequence with its DNA order, a CRO-ready lab handoff, and a full audit ledger. Every AI choice is cited there — literature, safety audit, and chassis checks included.

scenes.narration: And the guardrails are real. Ask for a toxin and the same server-side blocklist refuses — try it live, right on the page. No toxins, no pathogens, no synthesis protocols for flagged sequences — ever.

Then the loop closes. The Lab Guide walks any wet lab from DNA order to assay results — or preview the whole thing with zero setup in demo mode, from DNA order to assay results that feed the next design.
